map.样点法误差大吗？: Is the point-sampling method very accurate?
map.与布点数量和代表性有关，样点过少（<30）波动大；建议系统布点且避开林缘，视线仰: It depends on the number and representativeness of the points; too few points (<30) fluctuate a lot. Systematic layout avoiding the forest edge, with a consistent viewing angle when judging, reduces subjective error.
map.郁闭度与森林覆盖率是一回事吗？: Is canopy closure the same as forest coverage?
map.不是。郁闭度是林冠垂直投影占样地比例（林分级指标），森林覆盖率是乔木林地占土地总: No. Canopy closure is the share of the plot covered by the vertical projection of the canopy (a stand-level index), while forest coverage is the share of total land area taken by tree forest land (a regional index).
